Combine scales into a product index

Source: R/product-class.R
scale_product.Rd

This feature may change or be removed in a later version.

Usage

scale_product(..., name = "", desc = "", keys = NULL, joint_weights = NULL)

Arguments

...

Two or more named NestedScale objects; the argument names become the axis names.

name, desc

Short name and description of the product.

keys

Optional named character vector overriding the data key column per axis. By default each axis uses the name of its scale's leaf column (scale_leaf_column()); if that would make two axes share a column name, the AXIS NAMES are used instead.

joint_weights

Reserved; see ScaleProduct.

Value

A ScaleProduct.

Examples

p <- scale_product(a = scale_example(), b = scale_example2())
p
#> ScaleProduct: <unnamed> 
#> Axes (2):
#>   a : NestedScale 'example'  sector/class/group/item  leaves 7  key: item
#>   b : NestedScale 'example2'  era/period  leaves 4  key: period
#> Leaves: 7 x 4 = 28  (not materialised)
product_size(p)
#> $axes
#> a b 
#> 7 4 
#> 
#> $total
#> [1] 28
#>
